description: This Java source file defines the class OpenmrsSecurityManager, a helper class that extends SecurityManager to expose the protected method getClassContext() and adds a method getCallerClass() to determine the caller's class at a specified call stack depth.

classes.name: OpenmrsSecurityManager
classes.description: A helper class for calling protected methods on SecurityManager, especially for retrieving the caller class at a specified depth.

methods.name: getCallerClass
methods.description: Returns the class at a specific depth in the call stack, skipping over SecurityManager classes; throws an APIException if the depth is negative.
